upstream.previous_failure: R25 山月 hand-authored Figma vector technically passed but looked mechanical

primary_designer.creator: 张家佳
primary_designer.author_published_process: Source artist first analyzed sparse 上 vs dense 座 in equal-cell horizontal composition, explored integrated composition and re-drew curves; not simply stacking a commercial font.
primary_designer.confidence: AUTHENTIC_CREATOR_PROCESS_HIGH_LEVEL_ONLY; exact author source Illustrator curve coordinates not supplied

selection_reason: 云 sparse open structural pattern vs 间 denser enclosed character. Different topology from 上座, previously unseen in author evidence.
design_intent: Create a compact two-character lyrical wordmark with a cloud-like main horizontal echoing the 门 roof while preserving Chinese character identity.

A.description: separate original 云 first horizontal and 间 roof/door-hook

B.description: replace two separate naturally needed structural strokes with one lengthy physically connected top roof across 云+门, keeping rest same

C.description: abstain from direct shared stroke, allow a single noncontact elongated 云 top horizontal as directional echo
C.source_path: research/typography_r26/R26_C_云间_拒绝共笔后的留白回退.svg
C.exact_vs_A: Only 云/首横 data and bbox changed; 11 of 12 vector paths unchanged (native Figma readback PASS).

figma.creation_method: Model hand-authored SVG cubic outlines with semantic stroke IDs, imported into Figma as actual native editable VECTOR nodes. Not mouse-by-mouse manual drawing, no font outlines/raster path extraction or font text layers.

engineering_failure_and_fix.first_screen_shot: Large black triangle due to malformed SVG cubic segment inside 间/日右竖. This is a parsing error, not aesthetic decision.
engineering_failure_and_fix.fix_scope: Syntactic correction only (added missing cubic control point) in A/B, no intentional art direction change.
engineering_failure_and_fix.post_fix_Figma_screenshot: VISUALLY_INSPECTED true A/B/C at 1400px and at 240px

stage_review.B_reason_rejected: Whole cross-glyph top bar looks like a conspicuous bridge that suppresses a necessary glyph boundary; at small scale separation weakens. Style is not thereby professional.
stage_review.C_observation: The noncontact top stroke is legible at 240px artboard screenshot, but still too close to 间 left stem and aesthetically scarcely more distinctive than A.
stage_review.C_small_scale_warning: 11px at 1600px artboard becomes <1px at 96px wordmark-sized display, so independent tiny-size recognition has not passed.
stage_review.next: Stop this cloud-door shared roof experiment; prioritize a genuine artist firsthand before/after where actual entire-composition topology change visibly improves readability, with objective novice small-size recognition and blind style preference before transferring to a third structurally different word.
